**The fourth release candidate.** It ships inside [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.3), and **needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer**: it asks HMG-API for the Wi-Fi hotspot, which earlier HMG-API versions don't understand. On HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.2 or older, update HMG-API first; the HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 download already has this release in it.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.3

- **HMG-API now turns on the Wi-Fi hotspot for this mod.** Before, the mod commented out the hotspot line in the car's `featurexml.cfg` itself, which only worked on cars that have the stock hotspot file (the EV6, Ioniq 5, Ioniq 6). Cars without one (Korean units, the 2023 US Santa Fe, the older Hyundai and Kia software) never powered their Wi-Fi chip, so wireless couldn't start. The mod now asks HMG-API (`"wifi": {"hotspot": true}`), which adds the feature where the car has none (#41, HMG-API #225). On the EV6 and Ioniq 5 nothing changes.
- **Shared CarPlay identity** (isaacwisdom, #43). This mod now owns the one native change to CarPlay's identification message (`libiap2session.so`), and other mods can add vehicle and appearance information to it through an API instead of each patching the library: for example E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing's charging data. A new setting, **Shared CarPlay identity** (on by default), turns the contributions off. The library change applies only to the build it was made for (260507), only when its stock bytes match, and wireless works as before if it can't apply. Thanks to isaacwisdom, who drove it for several days.
- **More cars:** the 2022 Ioniq 5 (`NEEV`) on US 260903 (#39), and the Ioniq 6 (`CEEV`) in Canada on 260206 (#40, thanks to Weab-chan).

Everything new since 2.1.0 is in [2.2.0-rc.1's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.1) and [rc.3's](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.3).

## What to test

- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto still start** on cars where they worked with rc.3, with music, a call and turn-by-turn.
- **Uninstall the mod and apply:** the car's `featurexml.cfg` comes back as it was before the mod.
- **On a car without the stock hotspot** (Korean units, a 2023 Santa Fe, the older US Hyundai or Kia): the HMG-API app should show a Wi-Fi chip after a restart with this mod on (untested so far). These cars aren't in the mod's car list yet, so it asks you to install anyway; a Car Report afterwards tells us how far wireless gets there.
- **With E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing** (once it uses the shared identity): CarPlay's vehicle data (Virtual Garage) still shows.

## Known issues

- On-ramps with the car's-own-format setting still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD doesn't animate at them (#30).
- Left-hand-traffic roundabouts (#12) and the CarPlay picture recovery after a freeze (#16) aren't in 2.2.0.

## Going back

To 2.2.0-rc.3: remove the mod in the HMG-API app and apply, then put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.3.zip` (from [its release](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.3)) in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install <zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

An [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose) with your car, head unit software (e.g. 260507), HMG-API version and this mod's version, your phone, and a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
